title: Weekly sync — serving-runtime / infra / console: agenda & prep (2026-12-07)
content:
Purpose: prep notes for weekly cross-team sync (serving-runtime + infra + console). Use this doc to call out blocking items, decisions needed, and owner-by-owner action items.

Attendees (expected): Evan (owner), Aisha (infra), Liam (console), Maya (runtime), Jin (SRE), others as needed.

High-level agenda (30–45m):
1) Quick updates (round-robin, 2–3 min each) — recent deploys, incidents, perf regressions.
2) Blockers & escalations (10–12m) — items that need cross-team coordination.
3) Rollout & canary plan for quantized Llama-2-70B variant (10m) — console rollout steps + rollback criteria.
4) Infra capacity & cost forecast for Q1 (5–7m) — reserved capacity ask and burst plan.
5) Action items & next steps (3–5m).

Prep notes / talking points:
- Incident summary (last 7 days):
  - 2026-12-01: Partial degradation on eu-west-1 serving cluster during KV cache compaction. Root cause: compaction job throttling hitting IOPS limits on the metadata store. Impact: increased p99 latency ~120ms for 30m. Affected customers: 2 mid-market tenants on Dedicated. (Jira: RI-2468)
  - Mitigation status: compaction job backoff tuned; monitoring alert thresholds adjusted. Need infra follow-up to propose durable fix (storage provisioning or shift compaction window).

- Performance regression check:
  - Canary run for runtime changes in PR #987 showed ~2% throughput drop at tail for long seqs (>1024). Maya to confirm measurements and whether kernel fallback introduced.
  - Action: Maya to triage within 48h, include microbench on dev cluster.

- Quantized 70B rollout (targeted for next sprint):
  - Risk: quality vs latency trade-offs for int8 vs int8-legacy quant profiles. Need final decision on default profile for hosted API.
  - Console work: Liam to add toggle + rollout stage UI; Evan to provide rollout policy and Canary cohort list.
  - Rollback criteria: >1% drop in eval prompt pass rate OR >2x increase in customer error rate for canary cohort over 2 hours.

- Infra capacity ask for Q1:
  - Forecast shows peak daily token throughput growth of ~35% YoY for hosted customers; Dedicated demand also increasing. Proposing a reserved-capacity pilot in us-west2 (4 A100 nodes) to support early customers.
  - Finance will need number estimates for monthly commit; draft number: 4 nodes => ~ $Xk/month (TBD). Jin to run a quick cost model.

Blockers / Decisions needed (call out):
- Decision: storage approach for compaction metadata (provision higher IOPS vs move metadata to managed DB). Need infra recommendation by next Wed (2026-12-09). Owner: Aisha.
- Decision: default quantization profile for hosted API (int8 vs int8-legacy). Owner: Maya + product review.
- Decision: Canary cohort list for quantized 70B rollout. Owner: Evan (list to be shared in meeting).

Action items (tracked):
- Aisha: Produce infra proposal for compaction metadata fix (provisioning vs migration) with cost and timeline. Due: 2026-12-09. Jira: RI-2521.
- Maya: Run microbench suite for PR #987 on long sequence workloads; report throughput and p99 tail numbers. Due: 2026-12-09. Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/987.
- Liam: PRD + console toggle mock for quantized model rollout (include UI, rollout stages, and metric hooks). Due: 2026-12-11.
- Jin: Cost model for 4-node reserved capacity pilot in us-west2; include expected monthly commit and monthly burn. Due: 2026-12-10.
- Evan: Share proposed canary cohort list and final rollout policy in meeting; draft a short runbook for rollback criteria. Due: 2026-12-07 (meeting).
- All: Add relevant test prompts to the eval suite for quantized 70B (owners TBD during meeting).

Notes to self (scratchpad):
- Bring up compaction incident timeline and customer impact Slack thread during meeting (link in #incidents).
- Remind product about communication plan for Dedicated customers if compaction fix requires migration window.
- If Maya's microbench shows >3% regression at tail, we consider delaying rollout and run extra quant tuning.

Follow-up format (post-meeting):
- Send summary in #serving-runtime with 1) decisions, 2) owners & due dates, 3) links to PRs/Jira/Confluence.
- Update Confluence roadmap page (linked) with rollout dates and canary policy.

Quick checklist to prep before meeting:
- [ ] Attach incident timeline (Aisha / Jin)
- [ ] Have PR perf numbers snapshot (Maya)
- [ ] Draft canary cohort list (Evan)
- [ ] Console toggle mock or screenshot (Liam)
- [ ] Cost model draft (Jin)

Misc references:
- Confluence: serving-runtime roadmap (see linked_artifacts).
- Jira: RI-2468 (compaction incident), RI-2521 (infra compaction fix).
- GH: PR #987 (runtime perf change).

End of prep notes.

Personal todo after meeting: paste action tracker into project board, ping owners, and schedule follow-ups for any blocked tasks (especially infra storage decision).
